items.source: The mapping function is responsible to turn one record into one domain object.
items.translation: 映射函数负责将一个记录转换为一个领域对象。

items.source:
The mapping function is responsible to turn one record into one domain object.
It will receive the record itself and in addition, the type system that the
Neo4j Java-Driver used while executing the query.
items.translation: 映射函数负责将一条记录转换为一个领域对象。它将接收该记录本身，以及 Neo4j Java 驱动在执行查询时所使用的类型系统。

items.source: T - the resulting type of this mapping
items.translation: T - 此映射的结果类型

items.source: mappingFunction - the mapping function used to create new domain objects
items.translation: mappingFunction - 用于创建新领域对象的映射函数

items.source: a specification how to fetch one or more records.
items.translation: 一种用于获取一条或多条记录的规范。
